comment: Params 0, 1 and 2 are declared as X_PARAM, Y_PARAM and Z_PARAM but no widget is created for them, so they cannot be clicked. No family is given to any jack: what each carries is whatever the typed formula makes of it, so a colour would be a guess. The ERROR_LIGHT and OK_LIGHT names are swapped against their behaviour in the code, but the lamp shows what the manual says it shows, so the reader sees no conflict.
